options.content:
Gateway, primary WAN, LTE failover device and rolling traffic totals. LTE values are device telemetry, not carrier billing data.

Green, amber and red indicate explicit status. Blue is quantitative emphasis. N/A means missing or unsupported data, never healthy zero.
